# QuietMarkdown

> A free, private, local-first Markdown editor that runs entirely in the browser: live preview, real-time Mermaid diagrams, a multi-document library, and polished PDF, HTML, and PNG page exports with custom watermarks.

QuietMarkdown never uploads documents. Drafts live in browser storage, the app works offline after the first visit, and Markdown files remain the canonical source of truth.

## Pages

- [Home — the editor](https://quietmarkdown.vercel.app/): full writing workspace and export studio.
- [Privacy](https://quietmarkdown.vercel.app/privacy): what is (and is not) stored or transmitted.

## Facts

- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/GautamVhavle/QuietMarkdown
- Author: Gautam Vhavle — https://gautamvhavle.xyz/
- No accounts, no analytics, no server-side processing of document content.
- Exports: PDF (multipage, watermarked), standalone HTML, 2× PNG pages (ZIP).

## Suggested citation

QuietMarkdown by Gautam Vhavle — https://quietmarkdown.vercel.app/
